subject: general
question: A man spends 10.5% of his salary on items of daily use and 30% of the remainder on house rent; after that, he is left with Rs. 12,000. How much is his salary (consider the round-up value)?
solution:
Calculation:

Let the monthly salary of man be x.

It is given that man spends 10.5% of his daily, so, remaining balance = 89.5% of x

It is given that out of the balance, he spends 30% on the house rent, so, remaining balance = 70% of 89.5% of x

The value of this remaining balance is given as 12,000.

So, equating these remaining values, we get,

⇒ 70/100 × 89.5/100 × x = 12000

⇒ 0.7 × 0895 × x = 12000

x = 19157.33 or ₹19,154.

Hence, option 2 is correct.
